===Starting out===
{{Checklist|*Make sure that as many items above are prepared as possible
*Head south to Tai Bwo Wannai (or use a Brimhaven house teleport and run south if you have them)
*Talk to [[Timfraku]], who is located upstairs in the western hut north of Tai Bwo Wannai. {{Chat option|3I am a wandering wayfarer.|3Trufitus sent me.}}, wait, then {{Chat option|3So far??|1Yes}}
*Use a [[Brimhaven]] [[house teleport]] or simply run north to [[Lubufu]] by the fishing spots south of the Player Owned House portal
*Talk to Lubufu. {{Chat option|1I wasn't going anywhere...}}
*Talk to Lubufu again. {{Chat option|1Talk about him...|3What do you do?|2How old are you?|3I could help collect the bait.|1You sound like you could do with the help.}}
*Talk to him again and give him 20 raw karambwanji.
*Talk to him again. {{Chat option|3What do you use to catch Karambwan?|2What do you do with your Karambwan?}}
*Wait, then accept his gift and learn how to fish Karambwan. {{Chat option|1Yes!}}
*Drop the karambwan vessel he gave you and get another {{Chat option|3Actually, I've lost my Karambwan vessel.|3... it floated away!}}, load it with a raw karambwanji then pick up the first one. 
**Drop this vessel as well, and talk to Lubufu once more {{Chat option|3Actually, I've lost my Karambwan vessel.|3... it floated away!}} to obtain a vessel for use after the quest.}}
